The red hit-direction markers that show where you were shot from now appear in the new renderer, at the same strength as the original.
Fixed a rare freeze of several seconds while a level loads, seen on the Steam Deck after many level loads in one session.
Fixed two rare crashes while a level is loading, one of them seen in about 1 in 25 loads of one checkpoint on the Steam Deck.

The "Mouse noise gate (pixels)" setting now ignores slow, steady drift (for example a gyro lying still) instead of letting it through in small jumps; deliberate turns pass at once. It's still off by default; if your aim creeps, try 2.
Fixed some small textures looking blocky or streaky in the new renderer.
Updating the game on Windows no longer leaves the downloaded installer behind in your temp folder.
